class_weighting_investigation.explanation: Variant A (balanced weights) inflates probabilities for rare events (~3.3% positive rate), causing large squared error (poor Brier score) against marginal climatology. Platt calibration or Variant B (unweighted) successfully aligns probability magnitudes with empirical base rates while preserving ranking discrimination (ROC AUC).
